title: PtCu hydrogel self-supported metal–organic framework for sensitive electrochemical detection of o-sec-butylphenol
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00900F, Paper
Zhehan Yang, Yijie Huang, Mingfang Yang, Ruiqi Wang, Xiaoyan Wu
A self-supported PtCu hydrogel-based Cu-BTC metal–organic framework (PtCu@Cu-BTC) was sucessfully prepared to constructed a electrochemical sensor for sensitive detection of o-sec-butylphenol (osBP).
